description: The values \(F(n)=\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\) and \(F(\ell)=\mathbb N\) obey the full limit-set recursion rule, with \(F(0)=\varnothing\), \(F(n+1)=F(n)\cup\{n\}\), and \(F(\ell)=\bigcup_n F(n)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.limitSetValue_spec :
  (∀ (x : WithTop ℕ),
      Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.limitSetValue x =
        Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.limitSetRule x fun b => Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.limitSetValue ↑b) ∧
    Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.limitSetValue 0 = ∅ ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ),
          Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.limitSetValue ↑(n + 1) =
            Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.limitSetValue ↑n ∪ {n}) ∧
        Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.limitSetValue ⊤ = ⋃ n, Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.limitSetValue ↑n ∧
          Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.limitSetValue ⊤ = Set.univ
